text:
nina: dropping a compact-preview mock for the Alerting panel. trying to keep the preview a single line to save vertical space, but when dense spacing is enabled the row jumps when you open the preview. link: https://redwood.design/s/preview-compact-v2.png

omar: nice! repro steps: enable dense -> click preview chevron -> observe 1px-2px vertical shift. looks like computed min-height is fluctuating because badges wrap.

leila: also noticed that keyboard users land on the last interactive chip after expand. we should make the header the initial focus target and use roving tabindex for chips.

toni: content consistency question: we have "snooze" in some places and "mute" in others. users ask in support which one actually pauses alerts vs hides notifications. can we standardize?

nina: my suggestion: use "Snooze" for temporary time-boxed pauses, use "Mute channel" for channel-specific silences. update tooltip/helpcopy to clarify.

sam: +1. propose helpcopy: "Snooze: temporarily pause alerts for a set duration. Mute channel: silence all alerts to this channel until unmuted." short and explicit.

omar: for the layout jitter, quick CSS patch that helps: set a stable baseline and avoid layout transitions on line-height. sample:

```
.preview-container { min-height: 28px; }
.preview-row { line-height: 20px; }
.preview-panel { transition: opacity 160ms ease, transform 120ms ease; transform: translateX(0); }
```

nom: longer-term we should ensure badges use flex-wrap: nowrap and an overflow menu for extras.

leila: accessibility: when preview opens make the header get focus (tabindex=-1; focus()). Add aria-expanded on the toggle and an aria-live="polite" status text announcing "Preview opened for <channel>". Also ensure the preview panel has role="dialog" if we overlay it.

a11y-bot: auto-scan result: contrast issue on the "snooze" pill in dark theme measured 3.6:1. target >=4.5:1 for small text. Recommend darkening the background by 10% and increasing font-weight to 600.

toni: will update the token palette. also: preview header copy — "Notification preview" feels vague. suggestion: "How alerts will reach <channel>" or shorter: "How this alert reaches <channel>". which reads better in narrow widths?

nina: I prefer "How this alert reaches <channel>" — more active voice and saves chars.

sam: UX on long channel lists: overlay vs push. My pick: overlay anchored to the right, traps focus, Esc closes. Keeps main list stable and avoids horizontal scroll. But ensure we announce it's modal for screen readers and include an accessible close button.

omar: overlay anim: fade 160ms + slide 100ms from right (translateX(8px)). avoid scale transforms to prevent jank on some GPUs. also make the overlay not increase z-index to cover system toasts.

leila: presets for snooze: inline quick buttons (15m, 1h, 4h, 24h) plus a "Custom" that opens a compact picker. For SR users, the presets should be buttons with clear aria-labels like "Snooze for 15 minutes". Also include a small "Recent" list with the last 3 durations.

toni: telemetry idea: fire an event when preview is opened: `analytics.track('ui.preview.open', { mode: 'compact'|'expanded', channels: 8 })`. also track if user uses a preset vs custom.

omar: sample telemetry in handler: `analytics.track('ui.preview.open', { mode: 'compact', channel_count: 12 })`. I'll add it to the openPreview function.

a11y-bot: post-fix checklist: run axe + VoiceOver or NVDA sweep, keyboard-only navigation, focus order tests, and validate aria-live messages are not noisy.

nina: action items: 1) omar to push CSS min-height + transition changes and add telemetry (ETA today). 2) leila to prototype roving tabindex + header focus + aria-live copy (ETA tomorrow). 3) toni to consolidate copy tokens for Snooze vs Mute and update palettes to fix contrast (ETA Fri). 4) sam to build overlay dialog pattern with focus trap and entrance timing (ETA Thu). I'll update Figma with the new header copy and presets.

toni: small follow-up: add a feature flag for overlay vs inline push so we can A/B test which has better keyboard and conversion metrics.

omar: good shout. we'll gate it and emit `preview.variant: overlay|push` in telemetry.

leila: QA ask: once patches land can we do a paired keyboard+screenreader smoke pass? I can join.

nina: thanks all — will drop updated frames and ping here when Figma is ready :thumbsup:
